title: plugin-webhooks: a webhook subscription with method GET is admitted at save but can never deliver (every delivery carries the event body)
body:
domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUZKdq3PK2Sab53cT3

Found in review of PR #34067 (#33895, review-c verdict 6899211410, S1). Bug only: grade and state are left to triage's first touch.

## 维护者速读

- 现象：Webhook 订阅的 schema 允许 `method: 'GET'`，但每次投递都带事件正文。在 main 上，这类 GET 投递经消息 HTTP 发件箱会一直失败到投递死亡（fetch 拒绝带正文的 GET），从未送达过。
- PR #34067 之后：发件箱在入队时直接拒绝"GET/HEAD + 真实正文"，所以 GET 订阅从静默死亡变成响亮失败，但它依然送不出去。
- 待定：GET 订阅应该在保存时就被拒绝，还是改为另一种投递形状（例如把事件放进查询参数）。

## Evidence

- `packages/plugins/plugin-webhooks/src/auto-enqueuer.ts` ~L1247 and ~L1404 enqueue with `method: sub.method` and the event payload.
- `WebhookSchema` (spec) admits `GET` as a method.
- `fetch` refuses a GET or HEAD request with a body. On main, such rows retry until dead (`service-messaging/src/http-sender.ts` `sendOnce`).

## Expected

One answer for a GET (or HEAD) webhook subscription. Either it is refused when the subscription is saved, with the remedy "use POST", or it is given a defined bodyless delivery shape. Until then, the save admits a subscription that can never deliver.

## Seam

`WebhookSchema` method enum (spec) → subscription save → `auto-enqueuer.ts` enqueue → messaging HTTP outbox.

Prior rulings read: none found for webhook methods. A docs/adr/** grep for webhook × GET/method finds nothing that rules on it. ADR-0012/0018 make the outbox the HTTP substrate. No ⛔ conflict.

Dedupe words: `webhook GET method never delivers`, `WebhookSchema GET body`, `auto-enqueuer sub.method GET`.
